observations.note: The self-check preview was killed at the default 10-minute background limit and had to be started a second time, although the step says to call it once.
About 45 minutes went to repeated polling of the background self-check output, which a foreground call with a long enough limit would have avoided.
The polling used until/sleep/cat chains and read files outside the working directory, against the plain-single-command and stay-inside-the-workspace limits.
Source fixes were written before their tests, and the failure was only shown afterwards by reverting the fixes (turns 49-51) rather than by writing the test first.

conformance.item: Rules to follow: open task-notes and plan rule files with the read tool
Procedure 1: read plan, triage note, specs
Procedure 3: write the test first and see it fail
Procedure 6: after each phase run only the test files the rows name
Procedure 7: search specs the plan does not name
Procedure 9: call the preview once, change no file after
Limits: plain single commands, stay inside the working directory
